We summarize this and all of our key model assumptions below: Assumption 1. (i) Bidders have private valuations. (ii) Bidders play the weakly dominant strategy of bidding their valuations if their valuations are above the current auction price. (iii) Bidders are assigned to one auction and have one opportunity to bid in that auction. (iv) Bidders face no cost of entry or bidding in the auction.
